box(size = vec(1,130,20) , pos = vec(80,10,0))

for i in range(10) :

    ball = sphere(pos = vec(p,p,0))
    ball.v = vec(v,-10,0)
    balls.append(ball)

while True :

    for i in range(len(balls)):
        balls[i].pos = balls[i].pos + 0.01 * balls[i].v

            balls[i].v.y = -balls[i].v.y
        else :
            balls[i].v.y = balls[i].v.y + 0.01 * -9.8
        if balls[i].pos.x >= 80 :
            balls[i].v.x= -balls[i].v.x
        if balls[i].pos.x <= -80 :
            balls[i].v.x = -balls[i].v.x

            r = random.randint(0,100) / 100
            g = random.randint(0,100) / 100
